page.notes: The title is set in bold type across three lines. The first line is truncated at the right edge of this part, so "Technolo" is a fragment and the word continues on the other part. The second line reads "gia Kecke" and the third "manni.", with no printed hyphen visible at either break. Whether "Kecke" and "manni" form one word is uncertain from this part alone. The woodcut ornament between the paragraph and the catchword is decorative and not transcribed. The chapter numeral is printed as II (2); it is read as II. The italic "Atq;" abbreviation and the "effectivis" spelling are as printed.
